update.title: Added extensible shutdown animations to Wayfire
update.summary: Built a shared animation protocol and discovery layer so power actions can coordinate a fire transition and plug in other visual effects through the same interface.

preview.description: Fire shutdown transition spreading across a Wayland desktop

blocks.body:
## Coordinate animations with power actions

Shutdown Effect gives each animation two explicit handoff points. `READY` means the overlay is visible, and `BLACK` means the display is fully covered. Power Manager listens for those signals before advancing to the selected power action.

After `BLACK`, the animation holds its final frame through the handoff, keeping the display covered until the action takes over.

## Plug in different visual effects

Animation discovery gives packaged and custom effects the same interface. Each effect implements the shared lifecycle, allowing the renderer and visual style to change without changing the power workflow.

The fire effect uses that boundary to spread across the desktop, cover the prior scene, and hold the final black frame while the action proceeds. Other visual effects can hook into the same lifecycle.
